# `/ui-metadata` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /ui-metadata/v1/tenant

`getTenantUiMetadataV1` — Get a tenant ui metadata — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API endpoint retrieves UI metadata configured for your tenant.

- Scopes: idn:ui-access-metadata-page:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: tenantuimetadataitemresponse

### PUT /ui-metadata/v1/tenant

`setTenantUiMetadataV1` — Update tenant ui metadata — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API endpoint updates UI metadata for your tenant. These changes may require up to 5 minutes to take effect on the UI.

- Scopes: idn:ui-access-metadata-page:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): tenantuimetadataitemupdaterequest
- Returns 200: tenantuimetadataitemresponse
